title: Analysis decision flow
author: Faye Niu
purpose: Make the current-draft pre-inference accounting, dependence, conditional-method, uncertainty, sensitivity and qualitative-audit plan explicit, while holding the exact statistical method and sample size until D1 evidence and supervisor/statistical review.

review_findings: METH36-001: current-state wording identifies a draft or planned analysis protocol; the explicit future TO FREEZE gate is retained.

status.interpretation: A bounded current-draft analysis plan. Candidate method families and qualitative procedures remain conditional on the executed design, authorised evidence and a future protocol freeze.

limitations: The exhibit is conceptual author synthesis and does not report an empirical or inferential result.
It contains no sample size, participant count, result, effect estimate, interval, p-value, threshold, prevalence, time, token, cost, coverage, usability or human-benefit value.
Named statistical families are conditional options, not a preselected test suite; D1 evidence and supervisor/statistical review are still required.
The current analysis plan is a draft; the exact method, sample size and protocol remain subject to the explicit future TO FREEZE gate.
The exhibit does not establish that D1 has run, that D2 has opened, that the final reference exists, that C0-C3 have executed, or that participant feedback has been collected.
Aggregation, clustering and bootstrap wording does not select a resampling unit, interval procedure or dependence model; these remain design-specific.
A framework matrix provides an auditable structure for interpretation but does not make purposive qualitative records population-representative or convert frequency into prevalence.
Agreement measures coding consistency under stated assumptions; they do not establish source truth, claim validity or adjudication quality.
Preserving negative, null and regressive outcomes reduces selective-reporting risk but does not guarantee validity, reproducibility or generalisation.
The PDF is vector-only but is not claimed to be tagged; the complete TXT alternative provides a linear accessible companion.
